secondary_sources.claim: The verses move between Bb and Eb major; this corroborates key identities, not annotation timestamps.

songs.selection_rationale: Previously screened but never predicted in the prior 53-pack or six-song evaluations. Early ballad modulation and return; the chart has sparse guitar quality evidence, so abstention may be appropriate.
limitations: Only the reviewed early ballad interval is scored. Intro, opera, later rock section, coda and final modulation are unscored.
Alignment primarily uses bass-root sequence anchors; these verify timing and sounding pitch, not chord quality.
Bass and dyad-heavy chart evidence may not support independent key/scale inference despite a clear external key reference.

secondary_sources.claim: C major remains tonic; refrain Ab/Bb are borrowed harmonies. The later coda is also over a C-major pedal, but it is outside this cohort interval.

songs.selection_rationale: Fresh stationary control independently corroborated beyond a single-key Beatles annotation. Repeated borrowed harmony should not become persistent key changes.
limitations: Score only the reviewed, anchor-bracketed body; opening-chord ambiguity and later outro/coda/fade are excluded.
Isophonics Beatles annotations can omit changes; Pollack independently supports stationary C for this selected interval.
Chart chord labels/voicings sometimes differ from the published chord interpretation; the key reference comes from external sources.
